sampling: First five whole confirmation games per player sorted by SHA256(seed:game_id), independent of predictions or outcomes; restrict all arms to common target decisions if a donor is unavailable.
engine: Existing SinglePV 20000-node child search, mover POV, cached; frozen 5-point winning-chance tolerance and categorical mate handling.
purpose: Post-selection diagnostic of human similarity, reference soundness and mistake-size distribution; not another tuning set or a replacement for playing-style fidelity.
